name: sit-look-stand
description: A seated look, split out of ProAction/Take a seat. Record 4 of that file is the seated dwell (arms down, hands in lap), so sit keeps records 0-4 and ends seated, stand keeps records 4-10 and starts from that same frame. sit look left/right use record 4's body and only move the head (0 -> 20, byte 3 side bit), so the robot does not stand up to look. All values are factory records; the split files are silent (id 0x53) because the original 13 s Take A Seat clip no longer matches. Keep these steps close together: with a long idle gap autoStand stands the robot back up. Copy build/sit/final/*.sh to D:\SpeAction first.
